summary: Job Material Automation & Smart Purchasing (job material plan, reservations, shortage, PO proposal, PO detail, receive, reorder suggestions) — end-to-end verified via backend pytest (6/6 pass) and Playwright UI tests. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: PO status vocabulary mismatch with problem statement: task text mentions 'submitted' but backend VALID list is ['draft','ordered','partially_received','received','cancelled']. Testing used 'ordered' successfully. Not a bug, but worth aligning docs.

PurchaseOrderDetail hides the Receive button for draft POs (correct per spec). There is currently NO UI control to advance a draft to 'ordered' from PurchaseOrderDetail (only via API). Consider surfacing a 'Mark ordered' button so office users can advance status without leaving UI.

ReorderSuggestions.jsx groups picked items by supplier NAME matching via /suppliers list — brittle if two suppliers share a name. Preferred to add preferred_supplier_id to the /inventory/reorder-suggestions response.

Material 'Mock Aluminum Drip Edge': available=0 despite on_hand=30 because reserved=30 accumulated across prior test runs — expected math, but reservations from stale/completed jobs should ideally auto-release on job close/cancel to prevent drift over time.
Confirmed correct behavior: reservation via InventoryTxn(reason=job_reservation) does NOT change quantity_on_hand (verified in pytest and curl).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 test estimates→quotes→jobs via /api/estimates→/api/quotes→/api/quotes/{id}/accept for Mock Aluminum Drip Edge (customer TEST_SalesCust_d67e64). One draft PO advanced to 'ordered' and partially received (qty=1), lifting on_hand 30→31.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_job_material_automation.py (6 tests) covers: idempotent generate, snapshot waste in required, reservation-does-not-change-on-hand, purchase-proposal shortage+suppliers, reorder-suggestions endpoint, incoming-only-counts-job-linked-PO. Frontend flow verified end-to-end. PO status transitions valid values: draft→ordered→partially_received→received (not 'submitted'). Reserve UI button disabled when available<=0.

po-receive hidden for draft, visible after status→ordered; recv-qty + recv-confirm updates plan.received and increments material.on_hand (30→31)
Inventory > Materials > Reorder Suggestions dialog opens; reorder-empty state renders correctly when no material below projected threshold
Regression: job-create-po button still present on Job page
